read.en: SpaceX rose 1.3% on Oct 19 to $147.96, trading between $146.84 and $151.01; with 89 sessions of history there is no 100-day average yet. It is below the falling 5-day ($150.3), rising 30-day ($153.4) and falling 10-day ($157.7) averages. MACD has been below its signal since Oct 14 and is above zero, with the histogram still widening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 14 ($173.15), and RSI is 45.
read.zh: SpaceX 10月19日上涨 1.3%，收于 $147.96，盘中区间 $146.84–151.01；上市仅 89 个交易日，尚无 100 日均线。股价位于下行的 5 日（$150.3）、上行的 30 日（$153.4）和下行的 10 日均线（$157.7）下方。MACD 自 10月14日起位于信号线下方，仍在零轴之上，柱状图继续扩大；抛物线 SAR 自 10月14日起看空（$173.15），RSI 为 45。

read.en: The close held above the $145.4 Sep 28 low for a third session, and the day's high stalled near the 5-day average. Resistance is $150.3 (5-day), then $153.4 (30-day) and $158 (10-day average, Sep 21 high). Support is $145.4, then $140.7 (Oct 15 low) and $130.4 (Aug 20 low). A close above $153.4 would target $158; a close below $140.7 would open $130.4.
read.zh: 收盘连续第三个交易日守在 $145.4 的 9月28日低点上方，当日高点止步于 5 日均线附近。阻力为 $150.3（5 日均线），其次 $153.4（30 日均线）和 $158（10 日均线、9月21日高点）。支撑为 $145.4，其次 $140.7（10月15日低点）和 $130.4（8月20日低点）。若收盘站上 $153.4，下一目标看 $158；若收盘跌破 $140.7，下一目标看 $130.4。
